observations: Photo 0: Silver laptop open on a wooden table, screen off, keyboard visible, trackpad present, hinge design suggests 360-degree rotation. Black leather chair in background. Water bottle and books visible.
Photo 1: Same laptop from a side angle, showing the hinge and screen folded back. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Water bottle and books still present.

Photo 2: Laptop closed, showing the back of the screen and base. HP logo visible on the screen back. A sticker with model info is present but partially obscured. Hinge mechanism visible. Wooden table surface.
The laptop has a silver chassis, black keyboard, and a large trackpad. The screen appears to be a touchscreen based on the hinge design and seller claim.
No visible damage to the exterior in the photos. No signs of liquid damage or major wear.

claims.claim: London use hp elitebook 1040 g6 x360 touchscreen
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows HP logo and model sticker consistent with EliteBook 1040 G6. The 360-degree hinge design in photos 0 and 1 supports the x360 and touchscreen claim.
